Observed Evidence: LiveKit SDK listSipTrunk() and createSipParticipant() throw Error: invalid token; outbound calls fail with HTTP 500 safeErrorCode: LIVEKIT_SIP_ERROR
Root Cause: Expired or mismatched LIVEKIT_API_KEY / LIVEKIT_API_SECRET for project crm-8q9fuunw.livekit.cloud in environment
Targeted Fix: Regenerate API credentials in LiveKit Cloud Console; update LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET in Render dashboard
Regression Test: Execute SipClient.listSipTrunk() live probe; verify HTTP 200 returned

Observed Evidence: const [socket setSocket] = useState(null) never calls setSocket(socketInstance); telephonySocket and mediaSocket are permanently null in React context
Root Cause: React state socket is never updated after globalSocket instantiation; acceptCall and rejectCall emits are silently dropped
Targeted Fix: Call setSocket(socketInstance) immediately after instantiation and inside handleConnect
Regression Test: Verify telephonySocket is connected in CallWidget and IncomingCallModal

Observed Evidence: GET /telephony/my-ringing-call returns null during active inbound ringing calls
Root Cause: Query filters by participants.some({ agentId role: 'AGENT' }) but createCallSession initializes participants: [] during RINGING
Targeted Fix: Update query to match on calleeUserId: agent.userId OR participants.some({ agentId })
Regression Test: Execute GET /telephony/my-ringing-call with assigned agent JWT; verify ringing session is returned

Observed Evidence: Inbound calls diverted to waiting queue; eligible agent marked OFFLINE on webhook receipt
Root Cause: telephonyService checks if potentialAgent.socketId is connected; disconnected socket causes immediate status update to OFFLINE
Targeted Fix: Exchange valid CRM JWT during ERP SSO handshake; preserve agent reservation with 15s grace period and support polling fallback
Regression Test: Run npm run test:socket-presence and test inbound allocation with active socket

Observed Evidence: GET /telephony/health returns livekit: 'connected' while LiveKit Cloud API rejects all requests with invalid token
Root Cause: Health endpoint performs boolean presence check on environment variable strings without live RPC probe to LiveKit Cloud
Targeted Fix: Add active probe (await this.livekitService.roomServiceClient.listRooms()) with 2s timeout in getHealth()
Regression Test: Probe GET /telephony/health with invalid credentials; verify it returns livekit: 'unauthenticated'

Observed Evidence: Outbound call placed without agentId (sent as null); session created with calleeUserId: null
Root Cause: Dial pad inspects only localStorage.crm_user.agentId which is absent in ERP SuperAdmin SSO sessions
Targeted Fix: Extract agentId from useAuthStore in frontend; default to req.user.id on backend if agentId is missing
Regression Test: Place outbound call in ERP SSO session; verify session calleeUserId is populated

Observed Evidence: Carrier webhooks drop if Vobiz portal directs traffic to stale ngrok URL
Root Cause: VOBIZ_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_URL set to joyride-darkening-fifteen.ngrok-free.dev which is offline
Targeted Fix: Configure Vobiz carrier portal webhook to https://crm-uec-backend.onrender.com/vobiz/incoming
Regression Test: Send test webhook payload to production endpoint; verify HTTP 200 with TwiML bridge XML

Observed Evidence: UI displays CONNECTED and starts duration timer as soon as browser joins LiveKit room before customer answers
Root Cause: WebRTC room connection state is conflated with PSTN SIP trunk call answer state
Targeted Fix: Transition status to CONNECTED only when remote SIP participant attributes include sip.callStatus === 'active'
Regression Test: Initiate outbound call; verify UI displays DIALING until remote participant answers

Observed Evidence: Agent browser attempts connection to obsolete LiveKit Cloud project wss://23jy3gv6xcs.livekit.cloud if wsUrl missing
Root Cause: Hardcoded fallback URL from legacy development environment
Targeted Fix: Replace fallback with process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_LIVEKIT_URL or wss://crm-8q9fuunw.livekit.cloud
Regression Test: Verify WebSocket connects to crm-8q9fuunw.livekit.cloud when wsUrl is omitted

Observed Evidence: Origin: https://malicious-attacker-site.com reflected with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true on production
Root Cause: Permissive CORS origin evaluation reflects unvalidated Origin headers
Targeted Fix: Enforce strict origin whitelist matching erp-uec-superadminapp-zulp.onrender.com
Regression Test: Run node scratch/test-auth-audit.mjs; verify unauthorized origins are rejected
